'''Harvus''' was a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At some point after the Empire's [[Invasion of Begeren|seizure]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Begeren]]<ref name="Codex" /> in [[3678 BBY]],<ref name="Shade">''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith]]''</ref> a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Lassicar]] [[Death/Legends|executed]] his [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] parents and exposed their [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Begeren terrorist cell|cell]] to Harvus.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Harvus was mentioned in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in the entry for [[Imperial Guard|Guardsman]] Lassicar in the in-game Codex.<ref name="Codex" />
